front.title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE COMMISSIONERS' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO STATUTES RELATING TO PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT.

runs: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives in General Assembly convened:
Section 1. Subsection (d) of section 7-576e of the 2026 supplement to the general statutes is repealed and the following is substituted in lieu thereof (Effective October 1, 2026):
section, no municipality shall be designated a tier IV municipality, by any means other than that provided in subdivision (1) of subsection (a) of this section, until April 1, 2018.
Sec. 2. Subsection (b) of section 7-576i of the 2026 supplement to the general statutes is repealed and the following is substituted in lieu thereof (Effective October 1, 2026):

(b) The secretary may distribute funds from the Municipal Restructuring Fund to a third party on behalf of a designated tier II, [tier] III or [tier] IV municipality. Funds received by a municipality pursuant to this section may be used, in part, to pay an arbitrator selected pursuant to clause (v) of subdivision (3) of subsection (a) of section 7-576e.
